items.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 profit soars five-fold YoY to Rs 375 crore
items.description: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a remarkable net profit of ₹375 crore for the second quarter, marking impressive year-on-year growth. The company's loan portfolio expansion contributed to a stellar 75.6% rise in net interest income. Notably, new disbursements made up 28% of the total, exceeding ₹4,400 crore. The gross non-performing asset ratio improved to 1.2%, reflecting enhanced asset quality, while the capital adequacy ratio stood strong at 18.7%, indicating robust financial health.

items.title: DMart Q2 Results: Cons profit rises nearly 9% YoY to Rs 743 crore, revenue jumps 18%
items.description: DMart operator Avenue Supermarts reported an 8.5% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 743 crore in Q2FY27, while revenue grew 17.8% to Rs 19,644 crore. However, EBITDA and profit after tax margins declined amid entry-level wage inflation. The company opened 15 new stores during the quarter, taking its total to 518.

items.title: Canara HSBC Life Q2 profit rises 5% YoY to Rs 43 crore
items.description: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company's September quarter has marked a significant growth, with a 5 percent rise in net profit, totaling Rs 43 crore from Rs 41 crore last year. This quarter also saw total income climb to Rs 2,511 crore, a rise in net premium collections reaching Rs 2,553 crore, and an increase in first-year premiums to Rs 642 crore, showcasing the company’s robust financial health.
